in_force_since_evidence.quoted_span: [ Text of section as amended by 2025, 9, Sec. 43 effective August 1, 2025.  See 2025, 9, Sec. 136.  For text effective until August 1, 2025, see above.]

result.prior_version_note: Before August 1, 2025, the section contained only the licensing requirement: no person could engage in the business of finding dwelling accommodations for prospective tenants for a fee unless licensed as a broker or salesman under section 87PP. It had no single-party contracting rule and no rule on which party pays the fee. The documents do not give the date the licensing sentence first took effect.
